final_message:
Fixed. The bug was an off-by-one in `wrap()` in `src/wrap.py`. It compared against `width - 1`, so a line that was exactly `width` characters long got split. For example, `wrap("aaa bbb ccc", 7)` returned `['aaa', 'bbb', 'ccc']` instead of `['aaa bbb', 'ccc']`.

I changed the check to `> width`. All 5 tests pass now, and I haven't committed anything.

You didn't say what "isn't working" meant, so I went by the one failing test, `test_wrap_exact_width`. If you were seeing something else, tell me what and I'll look again.
